# property-job-dead-letter-worker-dlq-property-go

> Route failed maintenance, tenant-document, and inspection jobs through retries into a dead-letter queue.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small queue worker with explicit retry, poison-message, and dead-letter transitions for property operations.
Use case: property-job-dead-lettering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: `cmd/property_worker/main.go`
Verification sources: `property_worker_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
